correctness.rationale: For unweighted K_{p,q} (p,q≥2) the orthogonal L eigenspaces are E0,E_{p+q},E_q supported on A zero-sum and E_p supported on B zero-sum. PBH with N−2 coordinate controls forces one omitted vertex per part. Their two-site support projects nontrivially onto at least three distinct eigenvalues if p≠q; strict convexity forbids triple equal f-values. If p=q=m, the two supports e_u±e_v are eigenvectors exactly when f(mh)=f(2mh) or f(mh)=1, requiring N−1 inputs; any single omitted site works. Separate h=0 gives N. Correct polynomial factorizations yield F2 steps 2/(3m),2/m and F4 unique cubic roots γ/m,β/m; first-resonance matrices cI+(1−c)11ᵀ/N are strictly positive stochastic. Independently reconstructed exact rational Kalman ranks for regular and RK2 resonance cases.
